children: Reserve Rights holders have chosen the High burn position in the Burn Gauge vote, with 86.27% of votes. Under this setting, the protocol's burns are amplified 4:1 from the treasury and no RSR unlocks from it during the quarter. The gauge is re-voted quarterly by ranked choice, so the configuration holds until the next vote.

The result removes treasury unlock overhang for the current quarter and sets a burn-biased supply precedent that future votes can confirm or reverse. The realized burn of roughly $295k equals about 0.06% of float, so the direct supply effect stays modest. The quarterly re-vote means the setting is reversible rather than permanent.
The results are in, and suddenly it feels really hot in here...

title: Reserve Rights: RSR holders pick High burn gauge in quarterly vote - 25 Sep 2026
